title: Appraisal Panel Schedule: Home-Length Addition — In-Place Home Resale Guaranteed Resale Program
content:
**Appraisal panel schedule — length of the home.** The appraisal charge on an In-Place Home Resale file under the Guaranteed Resale Program carries a home-length addition, added to the package's appraisal fee into the appraisal sum. The home-length addition follows the length of the home recorded on the seller's Home-Site Lease: 73 feet or longer adds 60.00, at least 65 but under 73 feet adds 30.00, and a shorter home adds nothing.

| Home length on the Home-Site Lease | Home-length addition |
|---|---|
| 73 feet or longer | 60.00 |
| 65 feet up to but not including 73 feet | 30.00 |
| under 65 feet | 0.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical homes).** 73 feet: 60.00. 72.5 feet: 30.00. 65 feet: 30.00. 64 feet: nothing.
